newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil board sets $10 mln share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil board sets $10 mln share buyback.

text.p: Synder Oil Corp said on Monday its board had authorized another $10 million share repurchase program.
The company also said in a statement it had completed a similar $10 million share repurchase plan announced in May.
The company could repurchase its common stock, six percent preferred stock or seven percent convertible subordinated notes due in 2001, Snyder said.
So far, Synder said it had repurchased 714,000 common shares and $3.8 million principal amount of its seven percent convertible notes.
Snyder said it would fund the buyback from its internal cash flow or bank credit facility.
There was no time limit on the program and the company said purchases would be made in solicited or unsolicited transactions in the market or in privately negotiated deals.
